objective: Account a four-expert top-1 residual host whose stored union rank is 768 but whose physically active residual path remains rank 192 per token.
decision_rule: Pass only with union rank at least 768, exactly one active expert per token, no more than 800 MiB fp16 payload, less than two percent active-MAC overhead over v12, at least 4x theoretical source active-MAC margin, and zero source blocks. A pass authorizes only construction and invariant testing of a generic LayerCake host.
claim_boundary: No-model sparse-host accounting only; no artifact, quality, physical runtime, Phase 3 certificate, or superiority claim.
